notes.title: Pick up your mop! Crime Scene Cleaner NOW AVAILABLE
notes.notes:
Pick up your mop Cleaners!

The time has arrived, August 14th! Phones from the mafia just won’t stop ringing. Clean after their bloody messes and prove yourself to be the perfect man for such a dirty job. [b]Crime Scene Cleaner just launched on Steam with a 12% release discount[/b]! Purchase Crime Scene Cleaner, add it to your library and get ready to get your hands dirty!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/a45caf99e239b1f3854777fb95e98b2c72c8318e.png[/img]

To not worry about music copyrights, we recommend content creators use the 'streamer mode' available in the settings, or simply mute the music in the end credits. Feel free to stream!

If you have any problems with your game or see any bugs, please do not hesitate to contact us via discord (that's the place where we will be able to reply the fastest), steam discussions or the following address e-mail: help@president-studio.com


[previewyoutube=TG2jf0UxER0;full][/previewyoutube]
Enjoy your crime scene cleaning adventures and follow us for future updates! We hope that you'll have great time playing.

See ya!
[i]The Devs[/i]
